Sorry to hear about the water damage, Delphine. I have two questions so I can open the report.

What happened, and where did the water come from and what did it damage? Please tell me in your own words.
It's my house on Wrenfield Lane. The dishwasher hose split and soaked the kitchen floor. I don't have photos or an estimate yet. Please file it.
